title: The Bluest Eye
author: Toni Morrison
summary: In 1940s Ohio, Pecola Breedlove, a young Black girl, longs for blue eyes, believing that beauty would change her life. Toni Morrison shows the cruelty and neglect around her through several narrators.
readIf: you want a powerful, poetic novel about racism, beauty standards and childhood harm.
skipIf: you want to avoid graphic depictions of child abuse and sexual violence.
